title: Research Keywords for Campaigns with Keyword Planner – Google Ads

facts.fact: The page shows a Keyword Planner screenshot with a suggested bid of $1.72 for the keyword 'Clothing store', presented as an example and not tied to a date.
Google states that Keyword Planner provides suggested bid estimates for each keyword to help advertisers determine their advertising budget.
facts.quote: Keyword Planner will give you suggested bid estimates for each keyword to help you determine your advertising budget.

facts.fact: Google states that a Keyword Planner plan forecast shows how many conversions, clicks or impressions a keyword is likely to get based on spend.
facts.quote: Your plan forecast shows you how many conversions, clicks or impressions you’re likely to get for your keywords based on your spend.
